snippet.title: Spore Valley - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Spore Valley is a resource management puzzle set on an arid planet, where you grow an alien slime mold from a single tiny sporeling into a sprawling creature that fills the little valley where it was born.Make the most of limited space and resources, and balance your metabolism to avoid over- and under-producing resources, and your slime may just be able to complete its life cycle!Check out our links for more! Spore Valley is currently targeting a November 14, 2024 launch on Steam and Itch.io.
